title: One year of Chinese
blurb: A phone call with her mother, all in Chinese.

paragraphs.zh: 一年以前，我只会说“你好”和“谢谢”。现在我可以用中文跟阿姨打电话了。
paragraphs.en: A year ago, I could only say "hello" and "thank you". Now I can call her mother in Chinese.

paragraphs.zh: 昨天阿姨问我：“米格，你最近工作忙不忙？”
paragraphs.en: Yesterday her mother asked me: "米格, have you been busy at work lately?"

paragraphs.zh: 我说：“有点忙，可是我很喜欢我的工作。我们公司最近有很多变化。”
paragraphs.en: I said: "A bit busy, but I really like my job. There have been lots of changes at our company recently."

paragraphs.zh: 阿姨说：“你的中文越来越好了！”我说：“哪里哪里，还差得远呢。”
paragraphs.en: She said: "Your Chinese keeps getting better!" I said: "Not really, I've still got a long way to go."

paragraphs.zh: 阿姨高兴地说：“春节你们一定要来北京！姥姥也想你。”
paragraphs.en: She said happily: "You must both come to Beijing for Spring Festival! Grandma misses you too."

paragraphs.zh: 我当然愿意去。为了这一天，我学了一年。
paragraphs.en: Of course I want to go. This is the day I've been learning for all year.
